purpose: Reusable, hypothesis-swappable research harness. Keep the fixed method; refill the swappable parameters to study a different hypothesis.
principle: Separate the FIXED method (how you run a study) from the SWAPPABLE parameters (the hypothesis + its concrete lenses). The reusable weight is the lens taxonomy: it makes a study triangulated rather than an echo chamber.

phases.name: Frame & scope
phases.does: State hypothesis as a question; name competing options; set scope/audience; list cross-cuts; declare options given-not-exhaustive.

phases.name: Source discovery
phases.does: One BLIND agent per lens maps trusted sources (who/what, why-durable, must-read); does NOT answer. Includes a pattern-scout lens.

phases.name: Scope gate
phases.does: Human blesses scope: resolve split-offs, add counterweight lens if one-sided, set deliverable target.

phases.name: Deep dive
phases.does: One agent per option + one per cross-cut + pattern-scout, grounded in mapped sources; returns structured findings.

phases.name: Adversarial verify
phases.does: One default-skeptical refuter per load-bearing claim; verdict + survives-as.

phases.name: Synthesize
phases.does: One top-model agent writes the report: even-handed map first, then a flagged [LEAN] + steelmanned dissent.

lensTypes.purpose: Ground truth of the field itself
The durable tradition the hypothesis rests on

lensTypes.sources: a nearby field whose methods illuminate
risk, governance, the cost nobody is pricing
lensTypes.rule: Must dissent. If every lens agrees, you mapped an echo chamber.

lensTypes.purpose: Find options beyond the given set (the 4th/5th)

deepDiveStructure.agents: one per option + one per cross-cut + pattern-scout

verifyStructure.agents: one default-skeptical refuter per load-bearing claim
verifyStructure.rule: if evidence mixed -> holds-with-caveats; only holds if it survives a hard attack

synthesisSections: 3. Beyond the options - emergent patterns (FLAGGED, rated for promotion)
8. What would change the answer (2-3 flip-facts)

modelTiering.rationale: cost-gradient: grounded research + refutation = mid tier; the single keystone synthesis = top tier

claims: <load-bearing claim to refute: each option's strongest + the recommendation's load-bearers>
parameters.target: map | decision | design (or a~b blend, lean flagged)

instantiateSteps: 2. Pick 5-8 lenses by type; give each topic + seedSources; force >=1 dissenting counterweight.
3. Run phase 2 (blind source discovery) -> save <study>.source-map.<date>.md. GATE.
4. Derive claims from the source map.

instantiations.name: agentic-sovereignty
instantiations.hypothesis: How should a solo operator own/deliver AI-agent knowledge across brands?
instantiations.outcome: counterweight (governance) dissented -> A held-with-caveats as canon, C refuted as general substrate, B selective convenience
